title: plantool similar accepts free text and lists the best matches
description: plantool similar only takes a ticket id and hides candidates below a z-score of 1.5, so agents get one or no result. Accept free text (--text) so a new idea can be checked before a ticket exists, and list the top matches with their score by default; --strength still filters.
why: Agents need to check for duplicates and dependencies before creating a ticket; similar only worked with an existing ticket id and hid most candidates.

acceptance.text: plantool similar --text 'store data in a database' lists the best matching tickets
default lists the top matches without a z-score cut

outcome.summary: plantool similar --text TEXT compares a new idea with all tickets; the default lists the top matches without a z-score cut (--strength restores it). Ticket API similar default changed the same way.
